frequency_question: How often does a regulatory capital rule proposal complete the full notice-and-comment and finalization process within a 24-month horizon?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Board of Governors rulemaking proceeding involving capital requirements, stress testing parameters, or macroprudential buffers that reaches a final rule stage. Excludes routine operational guidance, non-binding policy statements, and micro-supervisory notices.

coverage_note: 4 named instances of major capital framework finalizations; approximately 5 total major framework revisions initiated in this specific class since 2010.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical amendments that bypass standard multi-month public notice-and-comment periods.
skeleton: Regulatory rulemaking cycles completed by the Federal Reserve Board of Governors since 2010, categorized by whether the complete lifecycle from initial proposal to final published rule occupied less than 24 months.
multiplier: 4 completed major capital rulemakings out of 5 initiated major rulemakings in the sample tracking window.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act statutory requirements and Federal Reserve internal review procedures remain stable across multiple presidential administrations.
